MANDARIN CHINESE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension.

   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Silent Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Creative Writing ● Coherence and logic of ideas ● Paragraph writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary building ● Scanning and skimming ● Comprehension.

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening ● Verbal and non-verbal cues ● Summarisin g ● Paraphrasin g ● C.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● Inferencing ● Decoding ● Active listening ● Summaris.

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Comprehension ● Vocabulary building ● Main ideas and details.

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency ● Articulation ● Pronunciation ● Intonation ● Stress ● Rhythm.

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency ● Reading with expression ● Accuracy of articulation ● Pronuncia.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening Comprehension ● Active listening ● Summarising.

8. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading ● Vocabulary development ● Fluency ● Inferencing ● Skimming an.

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information ● Reading strategies ● Vocabulary development ● Text str.

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Details ● Active listening ● Note-taking.

11. B — Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Silent Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Creative Writing ● Coherence and logic of ideas ● Paragraph writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descriptive Writing ● Word choice ● Vocabulary development ● Organization of ide; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Functional Writing ● Itinerary; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
